summary.text: In September 2023, Cook expressed optimism about broad economic and societal benefits from generative AI, conditional on addressing its concerns. In February 2026, she expressed long-run optimism that AI-driven innovation would improve people's lives, while also describing her approach to general adoption as cautious. In September 2026, she anticipated short-term inflationary pressures and a potentially painful labor-market transition, alongside long-run potential for AI-driven productivity growth to raise living standards for all Americans.
